reviewCharts.warning: Florida review rows use the official precinct-level 2024 General Election ZIP to pair President and U.S. Senate rows by county, unique precinct identifier, and polling-location label. Certified county map totals remain sourced from the official county detail table because the precinct ZIP presidential candidate total is 204 votes below that table and the Trump total is one vote higher. The ZIP registration field is retained as a denominator lead only; active turnout rows remain EAC fallback until compatible state-native ballots-cast rows are collected.

turnout.notes: Florida turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 county/jurisdiction fallback rows. The official Florida precinct ZIP includes a registered-voter field that sums to 13,942,186 across unique precinct/location rows and is retained as a state-native denominator lead only; it is not a turnout replacement without compatible official ballots-cast rows and because it differs from the EAC registered-voter denominator.

historicalBaselines.warning: Florida historical baseline rows are county-qualified aggregates of the retained official Department of State 2012, 2016, and 2020 precinct ZIP candidate rows. They have not been independently reconciled against a separately retained certified historical county or statewide canvass artifact. They are historical context, not replacements for the 2024 certified county-detail source; no historical precinct geometry is activated.
